postClaudeNResolution.N-1: Mechanical refresh only: manifest checker binding and this manifest hash were refreshed after independent-subagent governance evolved the checker; the review cycle is not reset.
postClaudeNResolution.N-2: R4-U01 now explicitly requires correction of all 12 ARCHUNIT refs to the catering-business-server test path and an item-by-item R2 standards N-2 enforcement-kind review before any phase activation.

expectedBehavior: R4 remains NOT_A_BUSINESS_JOURNEY and creates no account, session, UI feature, operations login or R5 business scope.
Every R4 machine gate has a one-line mechanical rule, production-driven validator, behavior-changing red mutation and a minute-scale scripts/verify path.
The standards matrix remains the source denominator; planned R4 enforcement fails closed until actual validators and evidence are implemented.
Testcontainers and scratch resources are isolated from DEV and report business/cleanup separately; static PASS never becomes business PASS.
Future UI design must first compare all-v2 counterparts, record CARRY/ADAPT/NOT_CARRIED, and preferentially consume admin-ui-foundation rather than duplicate existing primitives.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The design solves the actual pre-migration need: reliably exposing mechanical regression before multiple R5 modules and user surfaces amplify the cost of a wrong boundary.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Keeping only R3 focused checks leaves unguarded dependency, migration, generated-wire, retirement and affected-L2 drift. A CI platform or a semantic mega-checker adds more lifecycle and false confidence than this stage warrants.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Eight internal units share one orchestrator and reuse existing generators/tests; each requires a true red discriminator and the full verify run has a minute-scale budget. No new runtime, deployable, business data or UI is introduced.

conclusion.summary: The final second-round design review confirms that U01-U08 cover the Roadmap R4 deliverables, standards Part B-D mapping and future UI carry-over/foundation discipline without fabricating a Journey or implementation completion.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This GO is only for the R4 implementation-facing design packet to enter Claude/Dexter review. It does not authorize R4 source changes, dynamic execution, DEV actions, seed/reset, or alter R3/J02/C-02/TDP boundaries.
